hurdle: 3+ goals in the game (regulation and overtime; shootout goals do not count)
probability_label: Research estimate - not calibrated, no graded record
assumptions: Goals per game = shots/game (half last 10, half since 2025-26) x shooting % regressed to 9.5% over 60 shots, x opponent shots-allowed factor (0.88-1.12) x goalie save % factor (0.85-1.20); P(3+) = Poisson tail, which ignores game-to-game variance in ice time and score effects. Not fitted to 3+ outcomes.
market: No 3+ goals price in our feed; likelihood only, not value
